Rhythm transcriptions (in progress)

Rhythms, chords and (some) lyrics read by model from the real books (The Real Pop Book Vol. 2 and the Sher books). Pitches are not transcribed: every note is written as B. Treat each as a draft to review against the book. Not shown on the public site; reach it at /teacher/realpop-transcriptions.html. Built by scripts/realbooks/build-transcriptions.py.

In the scores: bars shaded amber are ones the transcriber marked unsure; bars shaded red don’t add up to a full measure. Each shaded bar has its number above it, and hovering shows the note. Under each title, the list says what is unsure; click an item to jump to its bars. Notes about the form or the whole tune have no bars to shade.

Open in Notation sends a draft to the Notation page in a new tab, with the same bars shaded there. Comments are your reminders per tune. They are kept in this browser at once and saved for good in apps/realbooks/rhythm-comments.json: after adding some, press Download comments.json, replace that file, and commit it (the page shows how many are not yet in the file).
